'''2010 Canadian Nationals Imshan Poolar LS There Is Good In Him''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Imshan Poolar]] at [[2010 Canadian Nationals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|DS2-L-thereisgoodinhim.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' The Last Errata
* '''Username:''' Ninth
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.1]]
